accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:affine-lock-compiler
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The compiler theorem is conditional on a supplied rational interior one-mechanism affine family with a passing tangent direction; it does not assert that graph failure supplies such a family.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Exact positive-rational denominator-lock compilation under the stated affine-template premise.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: sIDP is sound and complete for unconditional selected kernels on input-free COPAGs; sCIDP for selected conditional effects is presented separately, is sound, and its completeness is left to future work.
CIDP is sound and complete for conditional effects from a PAG without selection.
Discrete causal queries are reduced to polynomial programs whose extrema yield sharp bounds; the paper does not state a local affine tangent denominator-lock compiler.
The paper extends selected graphical notions including c-components and hedges to latent-variable S-ID and supplies a sound algorithm, while conjecturing completeness.
For a specified semi-Markovian graph, the paper gives a necessary-and-sufficient graphical condition and algorithm for conditional interventional identification.
The paper studies graphical and formula-specific positivity conditions for identification formulas without global strict positivity.
